validate:

  next: checkIdentityUnique

# The single duplicate check: reject (409) only when the new owner's WHOLE derived identityKey
# (normalizedTelephone|email|householdId) equals an existing owner's. This consolidates the former
# separate telephone, email and household checks. Because the telephone is part of the key, two
# members of the same household with different telephones have different identityKeys and are both
# allowed. Reads within the same write transaction as the insert so the check and the insert see one
# consistent view.
checkIdentityUnique:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdentityUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkHouseholdUnique

# Reject (409) when the request would join an existing household: the household is keyed on the
# computed householdId (normalized lastName + postcode), so owners sharing a lastName and postcode
# are the same household. A second such owner is a household duplicate unless it declares
# 'sharesHousehold', which bypasses this block and creates it as a declared household member. Runs
# after checkIdentityUnique so an exact identity collision is still a 409 even when sharesHousehold
# is set, and within the write transaction so the check and the insert see one consistent view.
checkHouseholdUnique:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckHouseholdUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkCityCapacity

# Reject (409) when the request's city already contains 50 or more owners. Reads within the same
# write transaction as the insert so the count and the insert see one consistent view.
checkCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: defaultRegistrationDate

# date forward to the next Monday, so the persisted date is always a business day. Runs before the
# daily-limit count and save so both see the adjusted date.
defaultRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.DefaultRegistrationDate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkDailyLimit

# Reject (429) once 100 or more owners have already been registered on this request's adjusted
# business day (by registrationDate). Runs after the date is resolved so it counts per business day,
# within the same write transaction as the insert so the count and the insert see one consistent view.
checkDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckDailyLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCustomerCode

# Assign the '<REGION>-<HASH8>' customer code: REGION derived from the postcode (else city, else
# UNKNOWN) and HASH8 the first 8 upper-case hex chars of SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName).
# On a collision with an existing owner's customerCode, append '-<n>' (smallest n >= 2) to keep it
# unique — reads existing owners within the write transaction so the check and the insert agree.
assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdId

# Assign the stable, shared householdId computed from the normalized last name + postcode, so owners
# with the same last name and postcode deterministically share one identifier. Runs before save so
# the id is persisted and returned.
assignHouseholdId:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdMemberCount

# Count this owner's household (owners sharing the assigned householdId) including this new owner,
# giving the household size after this create. Runs after the householdId is assigned and within the
# write transaction so it counts only owners already persisted plus this one.
assignHouseholdMemberCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdMemberCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

# Count existing owners sharing this owner's firstName + lastName (case-insensitively). Runs before
# save within the write transaction so it counts only owners already persisted, excluding this new one.
assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignBulkSignupWarning

# adjusted business day. Runs after the date is resolved and within the same write transaction as the
# insert so the count reflects only owners already persisted (excluding this new one).
assignBulkSignupWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignPossibleDuplicate

# Flag a soft (non-hard) duplicate: the pipeline only reaches here once the hard-duplicate identity
# check has passed, so set possibleDuplicate true (with possibleDuplicateOf = matching owner id) when
# this owner shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode but has a different telephone, else false.
# Reads within the write transaction so it sees only owners already persisted (excluding this new one).
assignPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

# On successful create, emit an audit line via the dedicated AUDIT logger carrying the
# owner id, customerCode and registrationDate. Runs after save so the generated id exists.
audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

  govern: [ transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (one of MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When present it is combined with the last name to form the salutation.
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The flat postal address of the pet owner. Optional and kept for backward
            compatibility: a request may instead supply the structured 'addressLine1'
            (and optional 'addressLine2'). When absent the server composes it from the
            structured lines. On the response it is the normalized, composed address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address (street number and name).
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; normalized the same way
            (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, suite,
            etc.). When present it is normalized and appended, after a single space, to
            the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be four
            digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's
            postcode range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Optional when absent; stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. Optional on
            create; when omitted the server sets it to the current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's optional date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. When present it
            is used to derive the owner's ageBand against the registrationDate. Optional;
            stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner already has
            the same last name and address (they intentionally share a household).
            Write-only; not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formatted '<title> <lastName>' when a title is
                present, otherwise just the lastName. Derived from the owner's own fields
                and returned.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three
                letters of lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned
                at creation.
              type: string
              example: SYD-FRA-0007
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode. Derived from the owner's own fields and returned.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners who live in the same household
                (same last name and address). Assigned at creation and returned.
              type: string
              example: 3F9A1C7E5B2D
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId>'. All duplicate
                detection is expressed through this single key: a create is rejected (409)
                only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals an existing owner's.
                Derived from the owner's own fields and returned.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3F9A1C7E5B2D'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the
                same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively. Assigned at
                creation and returned.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Derived from the owner's
                own fields and returned.
              type: string
              example: SYD-SMI-0007-M26
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: starting at 0, plus 2 when an email is present,
                plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, plus 3 when
                tenure (days from registrationDate to today) exceeds 365. Derived and returned.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level from 1 to 4, mapped from membershipPoints:
                1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more). Derived and returned.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's
                registration day at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
                Assigned at creation and returned.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's
                lastName and postcode while carrying a different telephone, otherwise false.
                Assigned at creation and returned.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                When possibleDuplicate is true, the id of the existing owner this owner may
                duplicate (same lastName and postcode, different telephone). Absent otherwise.
                Assigned at creation and returned.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region) derived from city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table. Derived from the
                owner's own fields and returned.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name derived from the locality (region)
                using a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Derived from the
                owner's own fields and returned.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). Derived from the stored telephone and returned;
                the raw telephone stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate computed against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64 and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Present only when birthDate is set.
              type: string
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
